title: FDP Agent Correctness Evaluation — Prompt Set & Gold Pipelines
description: Evaluation data for the paper 'The Fusion Data Platform and TokSearch: AI-Assisted, IMAS-Native Analysis of Tokamak Archives at Scale': the 18 natural-language prompts, expert-written gold pipelines, and recorded reference outputs used in the paper's pipeline-generation accuracy ablation on DIII-D, released so the ablation can be rerun against other models and devices.
